messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, that's exactly the issue. Please reset your APN settings to default by running: `reset_apn_settings()`

After you reset the APN settings, you must reboot your device for the changes to take effect. Please run: `reboot_device()`

Once your phone has restarted, let me know, and we'll test if MMS is working.

I have reset the APN settings to default and rebooted the device. After reboot, my phone is showing no signal and data is disabled in the status bar. Should I try turning mobile data on or check something else?
